rules.title: Changed files must have a manifest edge or an explicit exemption
rules.text: gate-keeper manifest-coverage trial (uda-lab/yomotsusaka#158). For each changed file in a PR, requires either (a) at least one manifest edge in .gate-keeper/dependency-manifest.yml whose from/to node resolves to that path, or (b) an explicit entry in .gate-keeper/ref-exemptions.yml. Uncovered changed files emit uncovered_file (FAIL). Covered files emit covering_edge (PASS). Exempted files emit exemption_applied (PASS). Files not in the changed-file set pass as dependent_artifact_unaffected. Fail-closed on unreadable manifest, unreadable/malformed exemption file, or unavailable git diff. Advisory (severity warning) for the duration of the trial.
